main_text.p: פָּדָה Redimere. Hiphil הִפְדָּה Redimi curavit. Hophal הָפְדָּה & Niphal נִפְדָּה Redimi.
פֶּה m. Os oris: metaphorice Acies gladii: plurale, פִּיּוֹת, פִּיּוֹת & מִפִּיּוֹת .
Hinc לְפִי, עַל פִּי Syllabica adjectio, ut Juxta, Secundum.
פֹּה Hic, Huc: עַד פֹּה Hucusq.; מִפֹּה , מִפֹּה Inde. Si geminetur, est Hinc inde: אִי פֹּה Ubinam? אֵיפֹּה idem.
פּוּג Cessare, Intermittere: Deficere, Deliquium pati. Niphal נִפּוֹג Debilitari.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are copied from a faded scan; vowel points and some letters are uncertain and may be misread. The running head and the bottom word are in Hebrew and only approximately reproduced. Several Latin words in the second half are partly illegible due to stains and may be misprinted.
